entries.rationale: Fourteen explicitly authorized stable package updates; preserve priorities/default, private state, historical evidence and the five-file Home-only overlay. / Vierzehn stabile Pakete gezielt aktualisieren; keine Modellaufrufe oder vorgezogene Pilotlieferung.

entries.navigationImpact: Paired README entries link the current rollout; previous evidence stays historical.

entries.platformAndExampleProof: Exact Bash/PowerShell matrix, archive comparison, stable routing/documentation tests; full local and native results recorded in rollout PR.
entries.risk: Installation does not authorize execution, human acceptance, home sync before merge or broader distribution.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Package, source, profile, evidence or authority drift.
